newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs seen quiet ahead of futures settlement.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs seen quiet ahead of futures settlement.

text.p: Seoul shares are expected to see quiet trading on Thursday after climbing sharply due to preparations to meet the settlement deadline for March futures contracts, brokers said.

They said trading was forecast to be duller today Thursday as most foreign futures investors had already squared their positions. Foreigners had pushed the index up in a flurry of last minute buying of blue chips on Wednesday to cover short positions, they added.
The composite stock index ended 7.95 points higher at 663.90 on Wednesday.
"There is talk that foreign investors will try to ramp the market again today, but this time domestics are ready and is likely to sell into that," said a Dongwon Securities broker.
"The market will move sideways," he said.
On Wednesday, the March futures contract closed 0.90 of a point higher to 66.80, while the underlying KOSPI 200 index rose 0.69 of a point to 66.83.
